items.name: Viva Vida SBC Open 2018
items.city: São Bernardo do Campo, São Paulo

venue.name: Escola Viva Vida
venue.address: Rua Domingos Lentini, 70 - Nova Petrópolis, São Bernardo do Campo - SP

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta para qualquer pessoa, de qualquer local ou idade. 
O valor das inscrições será de **R$16,00** a serem pagos **antecipadamente**.
As inscrições serão aceitas até o dia **06 de novembro de 2018**.
No dia do campeonato, as inscrições estarão abertas **somente** para o 3x3x3.
Para mais informações consulte a aba [Inscrições](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VivaVidaSBCOpen2018#4850-inscricoes)

venue.name: [Dibrugarh University, Dibrugarh](https://www.dibru.ac.in/)
venue.address: Dibrugarh University, NH-37, Rajapeta, Dibrugarh, Assam 786004

items.information:
The competition is open to all competitors. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the regulations and certain event-based time limits will be in place. 

**Steps to register on spot:**
Spot registration will be open from 8:00 a.m to 11:00 am on the day of competition for events that haven't started by the time you register.
Please bring your ID cards for identification at the college gate.



Please check information regarding payment and schedule under the respective tabs.
